questions.q: What does Genesis 20 show about adultery before Exodus 20:14?
choices: It was already sin; the Most High said, I withheld thee from sinning against me
questions.explain: God came to Abimelech in a dream: thou art but a dead man, for the woman is a man's wife.

questions.q: What did the Most High call Abraham when speaking to Abimelech?
choices: A prophet, who shall pray for thee
questions.explain: Restore the man his wife, for he is a prophet, and he shall pray for thee.

questions.q: In what way was Sarah truly Abraham's sister?
choices: She was the daughter of his father but not of his mother
She was not his sister at all
questions.explain: The sister saying was their agreement in every strange land.

questions.q: What did the Lord do to the house of Abimelech because of Sarah?
choices: Fast closed up all the wombs, until Abraham prayed
questions.explain: The Most High plagues a household over the prophet's wife, as He did Pharaoh (Genesis 12:17).
